id: title:Gilbert09:classify clickhouse deltalake s3 blips as transient

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion resilience against transient ClickHouse object-store failures
review.reason: Adds transient error classification and unit tests for ClickHouse-specific object-store errors, potentially improving warehouse ingestion reliability. Tier 2 assigned because implementation and relevant checks are visible, but shared error class and caller-side retry logic are missing, preventing establishment of Tier 3.
review.uncertainty: Tier 3 requires systemic implementation and broader validation; Tier 1 is too low for substantive capability. Tier 2 is conservative given missing shared error class and retry logic.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the shared error class or the caller-side retry logic, so the tier cannot be established. The score is withheld.

observations.behavior: Adds a check for ClickHouse-specific transient object-store errors and reclassifies them as retryable, while also adding a test.
observations.code_quote: if any(needle in raw_message for needle in TRANSIENT_OBJECT_STORE_ERRORS):
observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse ingestion could retry transient S3 blips instead of failing permanently.

observations.behavior: Adds a unit test asserting that ClickHouse-specific object-store errors are recognized and reclassified.
